about_the_game:
In this action-roguelite you play as the spirit of a fisherman named Theo, who died at sea and desires to go back to his old life on the other side of the ocean.

Since you are stuck in the Drift, the land between the living and the dead, you will encounter other restless spirits who've been dwelling and manifesting into abominations, preventing you from reaching your home.

Using your harpoon, you must fight your way from island to island with your fishing boat to collect resources, so you can craft upgrades according to your play style and be able to defeat the restless abominations.

Driftbound Demo features:

  • Introduction to the world

  • Encounter enemies and resources through the procedurally generated first floor of the game

  • First boss encounter

  • One weapon you can modify and upgrade according to your preferred play style

  • Additional features and balance changes may also be implemented based on learnings from your feedback during playtests.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 (Version 1909 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K (4 * 3400) / AMD FX-8350 (4 * 4000)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960 (2048 MB) / AMD Radeon RX 470 (2048 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 (Version 1909 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K (4 * 4000) / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X (4 * 3500)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 (2048 MB) / Radeon R9 Fury (4096 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Fight your way home through the Drift as the spirit of a fisherman in this action roguelite with a taste of souls-like methodical combat.
